expr: (() => { const btn = document.querySelector('button[type=submit]'); const form = btn ? btn.closest('form') : null; window.__submitted = 0; if (form) form.addEventListener('submit', () => window.__submitted++); if (btn) btn.addEventListener('click', () => window.__btnclicked = (window.__btnclicked||0)+1); return 'btnType=' + btn?.type + ' inForm=' + !!form + ' formAction=' + (form ? form.action : 'N/A') + ' btnText=' + (btn?.textContent||'').trim(); })()
(() => { return 'submitted=' + window.__submitted + ' btnClicked=' + window.__btnclicked + ' path=' + location.pathname; })()
